meta.name: agentic-tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development for behaviour a unit test cannot reach, by writing the expectation against the running app before writing the code. Declare the consequence first, watch it fail, implement, watch it pass. Use when building a user-facing feature, when the user asks for TDD on UI or full-stack work, when a unit test cannot express the outcome that matters, or when you want a red-green loop that runs against the real app instead of mocks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 先写下期待的结果看着它失败,再动手实现,直到它通过
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让测试跑在真实应用上,而不是靠模拟来验证结果。
copy.tagline_en: Write the expectation against the live app, watch it fail, then build until it passes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want failing-first tests running against the real app, not mocks.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在写代码前先对运行中的真实应用写下预期结果,看到它失败(红)后再实现,直到同一调用通过(绿),用 Reticle 驱动应用而非 mock;最后可把这条流程存成可反复运行的回归套件。
howto.when: 当你构建面向用户的功能、要求对 UI 或全栈工作做 TDD,或单元测试无法表达关键结果时接管,跑一个针对真实应用而非 mock 的红绿循环。

say.text: 帮我给这个功能做 TDD,先写预期再实现
say.note: 会先看到红,再实现到绿

say.text: 用 Reticle 对正在运行的应用跑一次红绿循环
say.note: 预期写成动作的 until 参数

say.text: 把这个部署流程存成 flow,以后当回归检查跑
say.note: 保存后用 reticle_verify 跑全部 flow

howto.what_en: Claude writes the expected outcome against the running app before writing code, watches it fail (red), implements, then watches it pass (green) via Reticle; it can save that journey as a re-runnable regression flow.
howto.when_en: Use when building a user-facing feature, when TDD on UI or full-stack work is requested, or when a unit test cannot express the outcome that matters, running a red-green loop against the real app instead of mocks.

say_en.text: Do TDD for this feature: write the expectation first, then implement
say_en.note: Expect a red first, then green

say_en.text: Run a red-green loop with Reticle against the running app
say_en.note: until is an argument of the action

say_en.text: Save this deploy journey as a flow for later regression runs
say_en.note: reticle_verify then runs every saved flow
